name: Lucas T. Ritchie
tagline: Top rated Securities Litigation attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: For twenty years, Lucas "Luke" Ritchie has focused his litigation and trial practice on complex business and securities disputes, investigations, and enforcement actions involving federal and state securities laws, the False Claims Act, consumer protection laws, and corporate governance and fiduciary laws. His clients include businesses ranging in maturity from development-stage to public and spanning sectors from fintech and traditional financial services to technology and manufacturing, along with their officers, directors, compliance personnel, and board committees, as well as investment advisors, Certified Financial Planners™, and other highly regulated professionals. Luke is well known for successfully guiding clients through the myriad hazards and exposure points they encounter when faced with litigating on multiple fronts – defending against not only civil investigations and enforcement actions pursued by federal and state regulators, but also parallel civil actions brought by private litigants and court-appointed receivers in conjunction with such investigations.

Luke has been interviewed regarding his cases and for his insights as a subject-matter expert in the Wall Street Journal, NPR’s Marketplace, the Denver Business Journal, the Colorado Sun, ColoradoBiz, LawWeek Colorado, and other publications and television outlets. He is frequently asked to present to the legal and business communities on topics related to Securities Law, investigations, litigation, and legal ethics.

Luke is also well known for his bar leadership. He chaired both the Colorado Bar Association’s Business Law Section and Litigation Section, and was a three-term Chair of the CBA’s Securities Law Subsection. Having been appointed by the Colorado Supreme Court, Luke also serves as a member of the Colorado Civil Rules Committee and a Commissioner on the Colorado Access to Justice Commission.

Graduating cum laude, Luke received his bachelor’s degree in philosophy from the University of Colorado, where he was a Presidents Leadership Scholar and a CU Rugby player. He pursued his legal education at the University of Denver - Sturm College of Law, where he obtained his Doctor of Jurisprudence in 2004. In law school, he was the recipient of the American Jurisprudence / Scholastic Excellence Awards in Administrative Law, Natural Resources Law, and Hazardous Wastes and Toxic Torts.

Mr. Ritchie is admitted to practice in Colorado and before the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado, the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana, the U.S. District Court for the Western District of New York, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit, and the U.S. Supreme Court. He serves as a fierce and tenacious advocate for the rights and liberties of his clients with a firm commitment to their needs.

Luke has received numerous awards and accolades for his notable legal work, including the AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell and a 10/10 rating on Avvo. For four consecutive years he has been named by 5280 Magazine as a Top Securities Lawyer, by Law Week Colorado as Barrister’s Best – Best Securities Litigator, or People’s Choice Barrister’s Best – Best Securities Litigator, and by Benchmark Litigation as Local Litigation Star in the areas of general commercial litigation and securities litigation. In 2021, Luke was named to the National Law Journal's list of Trailblazers in Litigation.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
